Implementation committed as 71c671cf on codex-pymovements-performance-protocol, stacked on PM1.1. Frozen protocol has23 workloads (13 paired,9 absolute,1 descriptive),24 input identities,38 pinned Python packages, explicit M3 Max host/runtime pins and prospective numeric gates: aggregate time ratio<=0.80 (>=1.25x throughput), large RSS ratio<=0.80, each paired warm/RSS ratio<=1.10, cold extra<=1500ms and startup<=5000ms; existing Studio p95 budgets retained. Median/interpolation remain absolute; non-equivalent I-DT churn excluded from aggregate.
Raw receipt schema/checker rejects missing cells/versions/units, different or empty outputs, reused process units, failed/timeout/OOM attempts and ambiguous counters. It deliberately awards no performance verdict.46 tooling tests pass; all synthetic input hashes regenerate; live Mote ownership and original pinned-wheel inventory pass; static docs/link/diff checks pass. Final receipt protocol SHA256:627f8ffc29037cda375e6e70cfb9eeb8d9595e2f2c16f157cd3ab282478b7ca8.
Final fixture review added sustained motion for microsaccades and a qualifying I-DT plateau; UI requests are frozen changing-state sequences with requested/presented-ref checks, not no-ops. Eleven bounded remaining adapter tickets are linked to the PM3 gate and PM3.2 collector; QC/reading adapters retain feature dependencies and Studio reuses S10.6.
Repository consistency checks are running in the disposable normal clone to avoid the known linked-worktree JGit problem. Logs and exit metadata: /private/tmp/eyes4s-pm3-20260927/. No comparative benchmark or optimization has been executed. No merge or push.
